notes.title: Cavyrn: The Next Generation
notes.content:
Hello!

It's been a while since we last introduced any new content/updates to Cavyrn on PC, but today is the day.

We've been working hard for the last few months to bring PC Cavyrn closer in-line with our game available on the Google Play Store, and have added a number of new PC-exclusive features and levels.

We liked the idea of an open-world dungeon crawler, but we haven't been able to pull it off to a good standard. Cavyrn is now a classic dungeon crawler with hand-crafted levels, lots of enemies, potions, traps, puzzles, and plenty of gold coins to collect!

New Features: Overview

 Complete gameplay overhaul to remove "open-world" and story gameplay (for now?)
 A series of new hand-crafted dungeons to explore and plunder
 Special "Rage" attack
 Sprint ability for faster dungeoneering
 14+ unique items to collect from chests scattered around the dungeons
 Unique puzzles to solve
 Spike traps, fire traps, and kinda-sus levers...
 Health & Stamina potions
 Challenging combat with rooms of bats, bugs, and more!
 A tricky boss battle


Closing remarks
We hope you enjoy the updated gameplay of Cavyrn, and we'd like to thank the folks that have bought our game for their continued patience with our slower-than-usual updates, and the general unpolished nature of the previous version of Cavyrn.

TTFN,
Cavyrn Team @ Void5

(P.S. Be sure to keep an eye on our website and social media for future updates, and future projects!)
